description: Look up dogs' OFA health clearances (hips, elbows, eyes, cardiac, DNA) and CHIC status by breed, age, and report year, and roll them up by kennel.

tools.name: backend_detail
tools.description: Fetch one dog's raw detail page (HTML) by OFA application number. Required: appnum. Optional: page-route (default: /advanced-search/).

params.name: appnum
params.description: OFA application number (data-appnum on result rows), e.g. 2682765

tools.name: backend_search
tools.description: Run one raw Advanced Search query and return the result table rows (20 rows per page). Optional: api_action (default: as_action), breed, test (plus 3 more).

params.name: api_action
params.description: Backend action selector (always as_action for searches)

params.name: breed
params.description: OFA breed code, e.g. AUK (Australian Koolie); see 'ofa-health-clearances-pp-cli breeds'

params.name: test
params.description: OFA registry code, e.g. HD (hips) or EL (elbows); see 'ofa-health-clearances-pp-cli tests'

params.name: report-year
params.description: Single report year (the backend keeps only one value)

params.name: chic
params.description: Y to restrict to CHIC-certified dogs

params.name: page
params.description: Result page number (20 rows per page)

novel_features.name: Kennel rollup
novel_features.description: See which kennels in a breed are actively health-testing young dogs, ranked by tested dogs, CHIC dogs, and latest test date.
